zooms.note: Right moment, held too long. zooms.wanted_end_range_source: Fable's reading, not a number Keith gave. First written as 30 to 32; widened to 29 when rule 1 ended the zoom at 29.5s, because the close click logged at 29.9s is up to 0.5s late (old half-second click timing), so 29.5s is the moment he closed the note.
